one_liner: Meta's Marketing API (Graph API) for Facebook/Instagram ads is broad and documented, with OAuth2 and system user tokens. Managing other people's ad accounts needs App Review, Business Verification and Full tier. An official MCP server is claimed but not confirmed by the supplied pages.
auth_notes: OAuth dialog with ads_management/ads_read scopes for managing others' ads. System user access tokens generated in Business Suite are static tokens (API_KEY-like). Facebook Login for Business is recommended for partners.
access_notes: Limited access tier is granted automatically when Marketing API is added to an app and is enough for your own ad account. Managing other people's ad accounts needs advanced access via App Review, plus Full tier (500 calls in 15 days, under 15% errors). Business Verification is required for Advanced Access.
blocker_notes: Multi-user access needs App Review for advanced access to ads_read/ads_management, Business Verification, and the Full Marketing API Access Tier. Limited tier is for development only.
